summary.text: Sally Harrell was first elected to the Georgia Senate in 2018 to serve the 40th Senate District.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Harrell was a member of the Georgia House of Representatives from 1999 to 2005.
Before entering the legislature, she was executive director of the Healthy Mothers, Healthy Babies Coalition of Georgia.
The biography says she received a Master of Social Work from the University of Georgia and a Bachelor of Social Work from Georgia State University.
